headline: Simbhaoli Sugars enters CIRP; NSE notifies creditor list (Version II)
sum: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited is in active Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process with the National Stock Exchange notifying a revised list of creditors (Version II), signalling progression through IBC formal phases post-admission.
implication: Publication of a second version creditor list indicates either creditor objections/updates or discovery of additional liabilities post-initiation; counsel should track NCLT orders on creditor verification and plan for resolution plan submission deadlines under IBC s.30.
detail: The NSE intimation of 18 August 2026 formally discloses Simbhaoli Sugars' CIRP status and the updated creditor registry. Simbhaoli Sugars Limited is a Uttar Pradesh-based sugar manufacturer. The release of Version II of the creditors list is a routine but material procedural step in the 180/270-day IBC timeline, typically following the creditor verification hearing. No resolution plan nor acquisition details are yet public.
